item.title: Cook Incorporated: Williams Cystoscopic Injection Needles, used for cystoscopic injection into the urethra, bladder neck, and bladder wall, Reference Part Numb Recall
item.product: Williams Cystoscopic Injection Needles, used for cystoscopic injection into the urethra, bladder neck, and bladder wall, Reference Part Numb
item.summary: The female Luer lock adapter component in the affected device lots may not have been correctly seated due to misalignment and inadequate torquing during manufacturing. Potential events that may occur as a result of this issue include increased procedural time and inadequate treatment. Product details: Williams Cystoscopic Injection Needles, used for cystoscopic injection into the urethra, bladder neck, and bladder wall, Reference Part Number 090001-S26, Order Number (GPN) G16112
